title: Inter won't lose Çalhanoğlu for free — two reports, two different stories #Shorts
description:
Inter won't lose Çalhanoğlu for free — and the two papers reporting it don't agree.
https://www.nerazzurridaily.com/go/yt/?ed=74
Blue means the club said it. Pink means only the papers did.
REPORTED · Sky Sport Italia (Gianluca Di Marzio), Nov 13: Çalhanoğlu's contract runs out in June, renewing him is Inter's priority, and Juventus are ready to sign him on a free transfer.
REPORTED · FCInterNews, Nov 13: Inter have promised Çalhanoğlu and his agents another meeting, he gives Inter priority, and Juventus only made a few phone calls early this year — never an offer in writing.
REPORTED · FCInterNews, Nov 13: Marcus Thuram is expected back with the group next week and available at Atalanta.
